segment.source: Renders capabilities with a state against each one — shipped, in progress, planned — as a dated list rather than a marketing grid. Use it for: public roadmaps, changelog summaries, beta programme pages, migration status during a platform rebuild, funded-project progress reports. Prefer 'Included Checklist' when the state is only yes or no, and 'Feature Grid' when everything listed already exists and is being sold rather than tracked.
